text: Eight years after a boating accident killed her father and sibling, introverted Angela is sent with her cousin Ricky to Camp Arawak, where she becomes [a target for bullying campers and counsellors|wrong|cruelty and humiliation]. One by one her tormentors die: a cook scalded with boiling water, [a boy shut in a toilet with a beehive|images|vermin and creeping things], a counsellor in the shower. As panic spreads, the camp owner [blames Ricky, who has sworn revenge|wants|revenge for a wrong], and the summer moves toward [a final revelation on the beach|ending|the hidden truth comes out].
